attackers_goals: An attacker attempts to change Active Directory configuration for persistence or defense evasion.
description: A new unverified domain was added to Azure AD.
detection_modules: Identity Threat Module, SaaS Threat Detection
investigative_actions: Check if the new domain is known for the organization. Check whether the user changing the configuration is permitted. Monitor network activity to and from the added domain.
